abstract: Dialect reflects distinct cultural traits and fosters special interpersonal connections. As corporate social responsibility (CSR) becomes increasingly essential for sustainable corporate development worldwide, this study employs CEO – chairperson dialect sharing (CCDS) as a proxy for cultural proximity to examine its influence on CSR. Using a panel of 1,350 publicly listed Chinese firms from 2010 to 2022 and a fixed-effects model, the results show that CCDS is positively associated with CSR. This effect is stronger in non-state-owned enterprises and firms located in the hometowns of CEOs and chairpersons, but it weakens in environments with low market competition and high financial constraints. The findings remain robust across various checks. Overall, the results suggest that CCDS enhances corporate socially responsible practices. This study contributes to the understanding of the positive role of cultural proximity in CSR and offers practical implications for corporate top management selection. The results imply that firms are encouraged to hire CEOs and chairpersons with similar cultural backgrounds to promote CSR engagement.
abstract_zh: 方言体现了独特的文化特征，并促进了特殊的人际联系。随着企业社会责任（CSR）在全球企业可持续发展中日益重要，本研究以CEO与董事长方言共享（CCDS）作为文化亲近度的代理变量，探讨其对CSR的影响。基于2010年至2022年间1350家中国上市公司的面板数据及固定效应模型，结果显示CCDS与CSR呈正相关。这一效应在非国有企业及CEO和董事长家乡所在地的企业中更为显著，但在市场竞争程度低和财务约束高的环境中则有所减弱。上述发现经过多种稳健性检验后依然成立。总体而言，研究结果表明CCDS促进了企业社会责任实践的提升。本研究有助于深化对文化亲近度在CSR中积极作用的认知，并为企业高层管理人员选拔提供实践启示。研究结果建议，企业应倾向于聘用文化背景相似的CEO和董事长，以促进CSR参与。

title: CEO–chairperson cultural proximity and corporate social responsibility

abstract: In financial markets, there are always many stories or emotions circulating slowly. Traders analyse the reasonable price of risky assets based on their own information or emotions. In order to explore the nature of financial markets caused by information transmission, we use a continuous time incomplete information dynamic random general equilibrium model to analyse the slow transmission of multiple information. A simple model was used to show the mechanism more clearly. The model effectively includes market characteristics such as momentum effect, reversal effect and bubble. According to the results of numerical simulation based on SP500, the model effectively replicates various market characteristics in SP500 market.
abstract_zh: 在金融市场中，总有许多故事或情绪缓慢流传。交易者依据自身信息或情绪分析风险资产的合理价格。为探究信息传递引发的金融市场本质，我们采用连续时间不完全信息动态随机一般均衡模型，分析多重信息的缓慢传播。通过一个简化模型更清晰地展示其机制。该模型有效涵盖了动量效应、反转效应及泡沫等市场特征。基于SP500的数值模拟结果显示，模型能有效复现SP500市场中的多种市场特性。
title: Momentum, bubble and information transmission

abstract: This paper studies mutual fund performance evaluation, where non-random missing data is an important issue. Ignoring sample selection issues can lead to biased parameter estimates and invalid performance evaluation. Therefore, we propose a novel Beta selection model to characterize this non-random missingness mechanism. We can significantly reduce the bias in alpha estimates, by introducing our Beta selection mechanism into the Noise-Reduced Alpha (NRA) model of Harvey and Liu (2018). A computationally attractive Bayesian estimation procedure is also provided. Simulation results show that our proposed method achieves superior finite-sample performance compared to classical fund-by-fund ordinary least squares (OLS) and the baseline NRA model. Finally, we apply our method to Chinese mutual fund data, and find that: (i) our out-of-sample alpha forecasts exhibit greater predictive accuracy across all tested missingness rates; (ii) approximately 18% of funds exhibit statistically significant positive alphas, suggesting market-beating skill; and (iii) portfolios constructed using our method deliver significantly higher returns than those using alternative approaches.
abstract_zh: 本文研究共同基金业绩评估问题，其中非随机缺失数据是一个重要议题。忽视样本选择问题可能导致参数估计偏差及业绩评估失效。为此，我们提出一种新颖的Beta选择模型来刻画这一非随机缺失机制。通过将我们的Beta选择机制引入Harvey和Liu（2018）的噪声削减Alpha（NRA）模型，我们能够显著降低Alpha估计的偏差。同时，我们提供了一种计算上具有吸引力的贝叶斯估计方法。模拟结果表明，与传统的逐基金普通最小二乘法（OLS）及基线NRA模型相比，我们提出的方法在有限样本下表现出更优的性能。最后，我们将该方法应用于中国共同基金数据，发现：（i）在所有测试的缺失率下，我们的样本外Alpha预测具有更高的预测准确性；（ii）约18%的基金展现出统计上显著的正Alpha，表明存在超越市场的技能；（iii）使用我们方法构建的投资组合相比其他方法能获得显著更高的回报。

title: Bayesian evaluation of mutual fund performance with non-random missing data: Application to the Chinese market
